body:
Founder real-time: 'can we build out the gta7 historical based railroad tech tree powered by real minecraft rails.' Progression currency is real rails placed (not Flow -- GTA7's existing currency has no spend mechanism yet, building one would be separate scope; 'powered by real minecraft rails' already names the honest metric). RailroadManager: 5 real historical eras (Wooden Tramway/Iron Rail/Signal Era/Industrial Rail/High-Speed Rail), thresholds 0/50/150/400/1000 rails placed, flat-YAML persistence matching FieldOfficeManager's own pattern. RailroadListener is the real gate: BlockPlaceEvent cancels powered/detector/activator rail below the required era, VehicleCreateEvent cancels chest/furnace/hopper/TNT minecarts below theirs (nearest-player-within-5-blocks as the plausible placer). /railroad shows progress. Wired into GTA7Plugin, mvn package BUILD SUCCESS. Deployed (jar copied, restart queued: sudo-queue/30). Honest gap: actual in-game behavior not live-verified, same stated limitation every prior GTA7 milestone carries -- founder should playtest. GTA7 commit 7468990.

⚓ ☃
title: VS6: historical railroad tech tree shipped -- real Minecraft rails (S202-29)
